summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and thin handler adapters for SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler. Also changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32, updated the three in-repo callers (output_path to output_dir), and added or updated four test files. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and flake8 are unverified. Nothing is committed. Please run the new and updated tests plus flake8 on the changed files to confirm.
